tools.name: add_watch
tools.description: Start daily monitoring of a Polish contractor: VAT status changes, whitelisted bank accounts added/removed (incl. the specific accounts you pay to), KRS liquidation/bankruptcy/restructuring. Alerts via webhook and/or e-mail. Re-adding updates the watch.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List your monitored contractors with last status and recent change events.

tools.name: remove_watch
tools.description: Remove a contractor (by NIP) from monitoring.

tools.name: payment_audit_report
tools.description: Before paying a Polish contractor: verify NIP + bank account on the MF white list for the payment date, check KRS and VIES, and produce a PDF 'proof of due diligence' (MF request IDs, timestamps, findings, SHA-256). Flags the >15 000 PLN rule (art. 117ba OP, MPP).

tools.name: check_vat_whitelist
tools.description: Query the Ministry of Finance VAT white list. Give nip (and optionally bank_account to verify the account belongs to that NIP on a date), or regon, or bank_account alone to find who owns it.

tools.name: get_krs_extract
tools.description: Current KRS (National Court Register) extract: name, legal form, address, share capital, board & representation, proxies, PKD codes, liquidation/bankruptcy flags.

tools.name: find_company
tools.description: Combine MF white list + KRS into one normalized company profile. Provide one of nip, regon, krs.

tools.name: vies_check
tools.description: Validate an EU VAT number via the European Commission VIES REST API, e.g. PL7740001454, DE811569869.

tools.name: contractor_due_diligence
tools.description: Concise risk summary for a Polish contractor by NIP: VAT status, whitelisted accounts (optionally verify a given bank account), KRS liquidation/bankruptcy/restructuring flags.
